I see... let me see if I understand your position - feel free to correct any 
misconceptions:

1) You feel that Ted K., whether or not guilty of the Unabomber attacks, 
should be freed.  I assume this is due to your agreement with his positions 
and his tactics.

Let's review Ted a little bit here.  He appears to have above-average 
intelligence in math, physics, and some other "book" subjects, but is 
socially inept.  In college, he chose to study an area of mathmatics which 
was a dead-end, thus limiting his chances for advancement.  After deciding 
his choices in life weren't getting him anywhere, he decided to run away and 
live in the woods, soaking money off his family to support his "natural" 
lifestyle.  For his plight, he blames everybody but himself, reasoning that 
he's too brilliant to have royally f***ed up his own life.

Hating himself for all his mistakes, and blaming everyone BUT himself for 
them, he decides that if the world isn't going to roll over, hold his hand 
and wipe his nose for him, then he's going to have a series of temper 
tantrums until he gets his way.

If Ted is indeed the unabomber, then the source of his hatred isn't 
technology.  His hatred springs from the knowledge that he, through his own 
mistakes, was being left behind in that world.  The world didn't need him, 
and he needed a way to take out his anger.

Unfortunately, with his disfunctional social skills, he rationalized a way of 
"punishing" innocent people for his own mistakes.  Those bombs weren't aimed 
at other people; they were aimed at himself.

I won't bother to discuss the "logic" in the manifesto - just the list of 
minor logical errors would take pages.  Suffice to say it was a second-rate 
paper produced by a narrow, warped mind.  Among the technologically paranoid, 
it wasn't even a very good thesis.  It was nothing more than a partial 
regurgitation of other authors' work.

2) You want the world to roll over, hold you hand and release a mentally ill 
mass murderer?  Why?  Have you made similar mistakes in your own life which 
make you feel some sympathy for this pathetic little man?  And if you don't 
get what you want, you too will have a temper tantrum in front of people who 
neither know nor care about your personal problems?

3) I'm not sure I understand the significance of your tag line.  Are you 
claiming that you too despise Leftists?  Or didn't you understand the 
Unabomber's point that he despised Leftists as much as anybody?

4) IMHO, you're posting to the wrong newsgroup.  Try alt.psychology.help.
